# clickhouse_service_backup_bucket (Resource)

You can use the *clickhouse_service_backup_bucket* resource to export the backups of a ClickHouse Cloud service to a bucket in your own cloud account (external backups, also called bring-your-own-bucket). In the ClickHouse Cloud console this is the *External backup* setting in the service's *Backups* section.

This is separate from the `backup_configuration` attribute of *clickhouse_service*, which configures the built-in backups. There can be at most one backup bucket per service.

~> **Note:** This resource is in beta. The API key needs the ADMIN role and the `control-plane:service:manage-backups` permission.

## Providers

The attributes depend on `bucket_provider`. Attributes of other providers must not be set.

| `bucket_provider` | Required attributes |
|---|---|
| `AWS` | `bucket_path`, `iam_role_arn` (optional: `iam_role_session_name`) |
| `GCP` | `bucket_path`, `access_key_id`, `secret_access_key` |
| `AZURE` | `container_name`, `connection_string` |

Changing `bucket_provider` or `service_id` replaces the resource.

## Secrets

`secret_access_key` and `connection_string` are sensitive and are never returned by the API. Terraform therefore cannot detect them being changed outside of Terraform. They are always sent on update.

## Overwrite protection

`Create` performs a `GET` before the `POST` so that an existing bucket surfaces a "please import" diagnostic. The check is best-effort.

## Import

```sh
terraform import clickhouse_service_backup_bucket.example <service_id>
```

Secrets are not imported. After an import, set `secret_access_key` / `connection_string` in your configuration; the next apply updates the bucket in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clickhouse_service" "svc" {
  ...
}

resource "clickhouse_service_backup_bucket" "aws" {
  service_id      = clickhouse_service.svc.id
  bucket_provider = "AWS"
  bucket_path     = "https://my-bucket.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/clickhouse-backups"
  iam_role_arn    = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/clickhouse-backups"
}

# GCP
# resource "clickhouse_service_backup_bucket" "gcp" {
#   service_id        = clickhouse_service.svc.id
#   bucket_provider   = "GCP"
#   bucket_path       = "https://storage.googleapis.com/my-bucket/clickhouse-backups"
#   access_key_id     = var.hmac_access_key_id
#   secret_access_key = var.hmac_secret
# }

# Azure
# resource "clickhouse_service_backup_bucket" "azure" {
#   service_id        = clickhouse_service.svc.id
#   bucket_provider   = "AZURE"
#   container_name    = "clickhouse-backups"
#   connection_string = var.azure_connection_string
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_provider` (String) Cloud provider of the bucket. One of `AWS`, `GCP` or `AZURE`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `service_id` (String) ClickHouse Cloud service ID the external backup bucket is attached to.

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String) HMAC access key ID. Required for `GCP`, not allowed otherwise.
- `bucket_path` (String) Path (URL) of the bucket. Required for `AWS` and `GCP`, not allowed for `AZURE`.
- `connection_string` (String, Sensitive) Azure Storage connection string. Required for `AZURE`, not allowed otherwise. The API never returns it, so drift cannot be detected.
- `container_name` (String) Azure Blob Storage container name. Required for `AZURE`, not allowed otherwise.
- `iam_role_arn` (String) ARN of the IAM role ClickHouse Cloud assumes to write backups. Required for `AWS`, not allowed otherwise.
- `iam_role_session_name` (String) Session name used when assuming the IAM role. Only allowed for `AWS`. Computed if not set.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) HMAC secret access key. Required for `GCP`, not allowed otherwise. The API never returns it, so drift cannot be detected.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Backup bucket ID, as returned by the ClickHouse Cloud API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Backup bucket can be imported by specifying the service ID.
terraform import clickhouse_service_backup_bucket.example xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
```
